name: Media Speech Persistence Privacy Criteria
description: Requires persistent STT/TTS storage metadata, failure telemetry, and audit records to avoid source-text-derived filenames and raw provider exception messages while preserving intentional governed speech artifacts.

criteria.description: Persistent STT/TTS source must use content-opaque generated TTS filenames and type-based failure evidence without raw exception-message or source-filename logging.
The STT and TTS modules must compile and their focused tests must pass with the privacy-safe persistence implementation.
Canonical execution, scoring, storage, freshness, and release interpretation remain owned by the Ghatana Tools Evidence Generator.

acceptanceCriteria.pass: Speech persistence privacy authority and module verification pass, and Shared records the canonical producer result.
acceptanceCriteria.fail: TTS metadata derives names from source text, speech failure logs/audit/status retain raw exception messages, source filenames leak into STT logs, module verification fails, or canonical ownership is violated.
acceptanceCriteria.reviewGate: The Ghatana Tools Evidence Generator executes and scores this producer; GitHub Actions is provenance only.
